question: Which country hosted the first FIFA World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Uruguay.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first FIFA World Cup was hosted by **Uruguay.**
 
• The choice of Uruguay as the host country was **influenced by its recent success in football, having won gold in the 1924 and 1928 Olympic Games**.
 
• FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association), founded in 1904, sought to organize a world football championship independent of the Olympics. 
 
• The inaugural FIFA World Cup took place from **July 13 to July 30, 1930.**
 
• **Uruguay became the first-ever FIFA World Cup champion** by defeating **Argentina** by 4-2 in the final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 1930 World Cup was organized to **celebrate the 100th anniversary of Uruguay's independence**.
 
• **13 teams participated**:
 
 
• 7 from South America: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay.
 
• 4 from Europe: Belgium, France, Romania, Yugoslavia.
 
• 2 from North America: Mexico and the United States.
